user_direction: Core boxing is the prerequisite. No additional campaign, environment, progression or ability scope until the complete boxing foundation is qualified. The supplied overview is guidance, not absolute; specialized trained techniques are not four archetype presets.
implemented: Native left-stick/WASD continuous body disk with independent guard, target and attack; no normal free root locomotion.

Ctrl/left-stick-click plus one directional stroke requests a bounded step; neutral rearms it. Facing, body axis/velocity, feet, support, recovery and one expiring step request are saved simulation state.
Head/torso offsets affect actual existing hit regions and the rendered target. This is not yet swept punch/guard geometry.

Foot plants, gather, weight transfer and lift are read by rendering; fixed limb constraints retained. Ring/root collision shortens the mover; starting inside the minimum spacing does not trap an outward step.
Hitstop preserves new step intent without advancing body/support clocks. Counts and clinches cancel stale footwork. Pad reconnection requires neutral.
Default eye camera follows the player head in the world. Ctrl+F2 inspects both boxers and their feet. Existing chase-camera tests explicitly select that retained view.
Native input tests now distinguish body movement from modifier-driven footwork; directional clinch taps remain functional.

controls.body: WASD / left stick; forward dip, backward pull, lateral slip
controls.step: hold Ctrl / left-stick click, stroke, return to neutral
controls.unchanged: Ten punch families, existing punch modifiers and H/LB special arm remain available.
